newsitem.title: UK: Boots shares rise ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Boots shares rise ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in Boots Co Plc rose on Wednesday ahead of Thursday's first-half results, expected to show a healthy rise in profits, traders said.
"Boots should have a good story to tell tomorrow," said one analyst. The stock was up 7-1/2p at 622-1/2, after yesterday touching a three month low of 607p.

Analysts expect the drugstore group to report pre-tax profit roughly in a range between 225 million stg and 241 million, compared with 218.7 million stg a year before. The dividend is expected to rise to about 6.2p per share from 5.7p.
